description: Update an existing PDF/HTML record template (its name and/or body). Use this, not create_record_template, when the user asks to 'change'/'update' an existing print template — it keeps the template's ties to print buttons and the payment flow.

body.description: New HTML body of the template (optional; the fields' html_name without brackets)

template_id.description: ID of the record template to update

name: update_record_template
